rows.prediction: Novak Djokovic to beat Ugo Humbert in Vienna. Four of five OLBG tipsters side with the Serbian, and the event-page commentary notes Humbert is likely to struggle handling Djokovic's well-placed returning patterns. Djokovic remains a difficult opponent to break down on indoor hard courts, while Humbert's left-handed variety has not consistently troubled the elite this autumn. The selection is Djokovic to win the match.

If Hurkacz stays efficient behind his delivery, the tiebreak and short-set math tilt heavily his way. Selection: Hurkacz to win.
